claims.title: Conservative joint GP covariance by one-sided Chebyshev attention
claims.scope: Finite features; joint fixed m queries; masked unnormalized signed ReLU attention; exact real constants.
claims.priority: Classical Chebyshev and scalar finite-rank acceleration are prior work. Extension combines joint readout and data-space Loewner conservativeness; external novelty unverified.

claims.title: Explicit raw-input RBF approximation with uniform forward predictive KL
claims.scope: Compact exogenous inputs, positive noisy-query variance, bounded context labels for the uniform theorem. Explicit feature degree and encoder/attention size.
claims.priority: Not generic raw-feature universality or scalar acceleration; quantitative RBF composition relative to inspected Brain records.

claims.title: Finite encoder grid with one fixed exact attention solver and valid covariance for every candidate

claims.title: Unconditional GP-prior Gaussian-NLL ERM bound and explicit consistency sequence

claims.title: Finite-feature hierarchical GP evidence circuit and mixture KL
